The Capital Punishment Project, part of the ACLU’s Center for Justice, challenges the unfairness and arbitrariness of capital punishment while working toward the ultimate goal of abolishing the death penalty. Qualifying applicants must currently be matriculated legal students and must be based in the U.S. for the entire duration of the internship.

The Team:

The LGBTQ & HIV Project seeks to create a just society for all LGBTQ people and people living with HIV regardless of race or income. Through litigation, lobbying, public education, and organizing, the ACLU works to build a country where our communities can live openly without discrimination and enjoy equal rights, personal autonomy, and freedom of expression and association.  

The LGBTQ & HIV Project was founded in 1986, but the ACLU has advocated for the rights of lesbian, gay, and bisexual people at least since 1936, and for the rights of transgender people at least since 1967.

We’re going to the Moon. Want to help win the work that gets us there?

At Advanced Space, we’re enabling humanity’s return to the Moon and building the technologies that will take us to Mars and beyond. We’re hiring an engineering student who wants to work on the business side of space as a Technical Growth and Capture Intern/Co-op.

Airbnb’s mission is to create a world where people can Belong Anywhere. As we work to achieve that mission, our cross functional Tech Operations and Programs team helps enable Tech organizations to execute and deliver on high impact programs and initiatives. 

The Difference You Will Make:

You will decide what the engineering world knows about Airbnb.

  • Our engineers solve hard problems at scale across infrastructure, data, and applied AI — and they write about that work well. Almost none of the engineers we'd most like to hire have ever seen it.
  • You'll change that, and the change is measurable. A year in, senior candidates should arrive already able to describe our technical work accurately, because they found it before we found them. Our engineers should be recognised names in their fields rather than anonymous authors. Airbnb should be the source people cite on at least one technical domain.

jobs.description_text:
About the Company

Armada is the hyperscaler for the edge, delivering modular AI infrastructure from first deployment to AI factory with speed, scale and sovereignty. Named one of Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies and to the CNBC Disruptor 50, Armada’s solutions are deployed in over 60 countries globally for organizations ranging from energy to defense. 

With nearly $500 million in funding to date, Armada is backed by leading investors including Founders Fund, Lux, BlackRock and Microsoft (M12), alongside strategic partnerships with Microsoft, Dell, Palantir, NVIDIA, SpaceX, and Skydio. We are building the infrastructure layer for sovereign and edge AI - rugged, deployable compute for customers that cannot rely on centralized cloud.

Working at Armada means taking ownership, driving autonomy, and delivering impact. You’ll tackle challenges that haven’t been solved before and help build something transformative from the ground up. What you do here will not only define your career but help further Armada’s mission to bridge the digital divide for customers around the world.

Astranis builds advanced satellites for high orbits, expanding humanity’s reach into the solar system. Today Astranis satellites provide dedicated, secure networks to highly-sophisticated customers across the globe – large enterprises, sovereign governments, and the US military. 

With five satellites on orbit and many more set to launch soon, the company is servicing a backlog of more than $1 billion of commercial contracts. Astranis is the preferred satellite communications partner for buyers with stringent requirements for uptime, data security, network visibility, and customization.

Astranis has raised over $1.2 billion from some of the world’s best investors, including Andreessen Horowitz, Baillie Gifford, Blackrock, Fidelity, Franklin Templeton, and Snowpoint, and employs a team of 500 engineers and entrepreneurs. Astranis designs, builds, and operates its satellites out of its 153,000 sq. ft. headquarters in Northern California, USA.

Director, USG Capture Management

This position is responsible for helping secure US Government contracts, partnering with the Business Development (BD) team to transition opportunities into winning captures. The Director, USG Capture Management, will be responsible for leading the end-to-end capture lifecycle, from early-stage opportunity identification and strategy development through proposal submission and post-award transition.

jobs.title: Receptionist
jobs.location_raw: New York, New York, United States
jobs.description_text:
Background

Bloomberg Philanthropies works to create catalytic change across five areas of focus: arts and culture, education, the environment, government innovation, and public health. Our mission is to ensure better, longer lives for the greatest number of people. Our approach is rooted in Mike Bloomberg's unique experience and success across the field of business, government, and philanthropy.

The Position

Bloomberg Philanthropies’ Operations Department has an open position for a front of house reception position in New York City. Our Reception team is the first point of contact and provides the first impression for the various groups we support. The position requires interaction with employees, clients, high profile visitors, various levels of management, and vendors. This position collaborates with other on-site operations staff and will provide back up when needed for other departments including assisting with catering, reporting facilities issues and coordinating vendor services when needed. 

This position is coverage based and in person; hours are scheduled in advance and range from 7am – 4pm, 8am – 5pm, 9am – 6pm or 10am – 7pm on most days. There may be instances of early or late coverage as needed.</

jobs.description_text:
Blue Sky Innovators is seeking a Security Specialist to join our team in Arlington, VA. The Security Specialist will perform a wide range of day-to-day administrative security activities associated with highly sensitive and classified environments, including security management of all security aspects related to a Sensitive Compartmentalized Information Facility (SCIF) and, if necessary, a Special Access Program Facility (SAPF).

The Security Specialist will assist the Program Manager (PM) and Program Security Officer (PSO) with the overall security management functions of the SCIF and, if necessary, a SAPF. This includes conducting security reviews, inspections and accreditation for the SCIF and SAPF. The Security Specialist will process visitor requests, maintain personnel access databases and security files; review documents for appropriate classification; and provide initial, annual and exit security training.

The Security Specialist will also assist the PSO and Information Systems Security Officer (ISSO) with all security requirements of a SCIF and SAPF, including network and physical security, and associated documentation.

The candidate will ensure adherence to applicable laws as well as national, DoW, and other SAP security policies and requirements such as DoW Special Access Program (SAP) Security Manuals: DoDM 5205.07 Volumes 1 - 4.

Cartesian is building spatial intelligence for indoor environments to drive operational efficiency. We’re tackling one of the biggest challenges in the $35T global retail industry: in-store inventory visibility. By fusing wireless signals and mobile computer vision, we provide a uniquely scalable, infrastructure-free solution already deployed by international fashion brands. 

Founded by an MIT engineering professor and alumni behind award-winning, patented core technologies, Cartesian spun out in 2023. Originally backed by a U.S. National Science Foundation SBIR Award, we’ve bootstrapped to a live product now deployed in multiple countries and are scaling aggressively.

We are looking for an Applied ML/CS PhD intern to join Cartesian at an exciting moment in our growth. Chime is hiring a Workplace Experience Coordinator for our New York City office. You'll own a core set of the day-to-day operations of our recently opened 84,000 sq. ft. space, working closely with our Workplace Experience Lead based in New York City and our Regional Workplace Manager based in Chicago as part of a small, hands-on team.

The Service Manager (Condo) is responsible for the seamless operation, maintenance, and presentation of all building systems within a luxury high-residences. The position of Installer for Construction Resources will be responsible for the proper installation of various types of glass and mirrors.   • Attach all necessary hardware correctly as per job specifications
  • Install bath accessories, erect custom shelving units and install mirrors
  • Completes other duties as assigned

Minimum Qualifications

  • High School education or equivalency required
  • Experience in the construction/ Carpentry industry is required
  • Prior glass work experience preferred
  • Must possess a valid driver’s license with good driving record

jobs.title: Senior Financial Analyst, Corporate FP&A
jobs.description_text:
Senior Financial Analyst, Corporate FP&A

Please note, this position is not currently eligible for remote work or relocation. 

Position Summary

The Senior Financial Analyst is a key member of the Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A) team, responsible for supporting executive leadership through financial reporting, forecasting, budgeting, business performance analysis, and strategic decision support.

The Senior Financial Analyst will lead critical month-end reporting processes, develop executive-level financial presentations, and identify opportunities to improve reporting efficiency and automation.

This role will serve as a trusted business partner to cross-functional leaders, translating financial results into actionable insights that support operational decisions and company-wide initiatives.

The ideal candidate possesses strong financial acumen, advanced analytical capabilities, excellent communication skills, and the ability to influence business decisions through data-driven insights.

The candidate should be ambitious, intellectually curious, and eager to leverage emerging tools and technology to improve how financial insights are developed, communicated, and acted upon.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Financial Planning & Analysis
  • Prepare monthly, quarterly, and annual financial analyses for executive leadership.</

Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

Anthropic is looking for a Customer Marketing Manager to make sure our most important messages are backed by customers who can speak to them. This role works across regions and customer segments on special projects tied to the company's top priorities.

When we launch a new model, feature, or initiative, you'll find the customers who can speak to it and get them on the record. We're looking for an excellent communicator who can turn customer stories into multiple formats that flex across channels. This often means working under compressed timelines and leading customer storytelling on some of the most important projects at Anthropic.

You'll work closely with Product Marketing, Sales, Brand, Comms, Customer Marketing segment leads, and the writers on our team. The right person has done both product marketing and customer marketing, and has a reporter's nose for a good story.

About the Role

Anthropic's Executive Briefing program brings senior leaders from our most strategic customers together with our spokespeople, product leaders, and researchers. As a Program Manager, Executive Briefings, you will run the program at one of our briefing centers and help build the global operating model that ensures an exceptional and consistent experience across the globe.

You will be the main program lead for your location and own briefings end to end: qualification and intake, agenda design, speaker selection, and day-of execution. You will set the objectives and design for each agenda and develop it jointly with Sales. You will also be the local account teams' go-to partner on how to use a briefing to move their most important opportunities forward.
